mapper.sql: ${alias} VCATN_SET AS ( SELECT T2.* FROM ( SELECT MAX(COPA_INDEX_SN) AS COPA_INDEX_SN FROM AYC130 WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND APLY_SE_CD = '01' AND APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND #{WORKYMD} BETWEEN VCATN_BGNG_YMD AND VCATN_END_YMD GROUP BY USER_ID ) T1 , AYC130 T2 WHERE 1=1 AND T2.COPA_INDEX_SN = T1.COPA_INDEX_SN )

/* * 2023.03.02 _ 수정사항 * TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD IN ( '324','325','326' ) * ▶ TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD IN ( * SELECT DEPT_CD * FROM SAA300 * WHERE INST_NO = '1000000947' * AND DEL_YN = 'N' * ) */ /*TIME TABLE */ ${alias} TIME_SET AS ( SELECT ROWNUM AS TIME_CODE , START_TIME AS START_TIME , END_TIME AS END_TIME FROM ( SELECT MAX(BGNG_HR) AS START_TIME , MAX(END_HR) AS END_TIME FROM AYC110 WHERE CRTR_YM = SUBSTR(#{WORKYMD},1,6) AND TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD IN ( SELECT DEPT_CD FROM SAA300 WHERE INST_NO = '1000000947' AND DEL_YN = 'N' ) GROUP BY BGNG_HR , END_HR ORDER BY BGNG_HR , END_HR ) )
mapper.select:
/*dsTime*/
SELECT TIME_CODE , START_TIME , END_TIME FROM TIME_SET

/*dsCyberTime*/
SELECT TIME_SET.TIME_CODE AS TIME_CODE , MM.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AS IDX , MM.BGNG_HR AS START_TIME , MM.END_HR AS END_TIME , ' ' AS CONS_PARTY_IDX , DD.USER_ID AS CONS_ID , (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(SCA100.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 , SAA200 WHERE DD.USER_ID = SAA200.USER_ID AND SAA200.ENFSN_NO = SCA100.ENFSN_NO ) AS CONS_NAME , TO_CHAR(DD.APRV_DT,'YYYYMMDD') AS INS_DATE , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'VCATN_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = VV.VCATN_SE_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS HOLI_TYPE , VV.VCATN_BGNG_YMD AS HOLI_START_1 , VV.VCATN_END_YMD AS HOLI_END_1 , CASE WHEN VV.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' THEN '승인' ELSE '' END AS HOLI_STATUS FROM (SELECT BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO , CRTR_YM , BGNG_HR , END_HR , TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD FROM AYC110 WHERE CRTR_YM = SUBSTR(#{WORKYMD},1,6) AND TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD IN ('324') ) MM LEFT OUTER JOIN AYC100 DD ON MM.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = DD.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD AND MM.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = DD.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND DD.WORK_YMD = #{WORKYMD} LEFT OUTER JOIN VCATN_SET VV ON DD.USER_ID = VV.USER_ID , TIME_SET WHERE TIME_SET.START_TIME = MM.BGNG_HR AND TIME_SET.END_TIME = MM.END_HR ORDER BY TIME_SET.TIME_CODE

/*dsMobileTime*/
SELECT TIME_SET.TIME_CODE AS TIME_CODE , MM.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AS IDX , MM.BGNG_HR AS START_TIME , MM.END_HR AS END_TIME , ' ' AS CONS_PARTY_IDX , DD.USER_ID AS CONS_ID , (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(SCA100.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 , SAA200 WHERE DD.USER_ID = SAA200.USER_ID AND SAA200.ENFSN_NO = SCA100.ENFSN_NO ) AS CONS_NAME , TO_CHAR(DD.APRV_DT,'YYYYMMDD') AS INS_DATE , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'VCATN_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = VV.VCATN_SE_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS HOLI_TYPE , VV.VCATN_BGNG_YMD AS HOLI_START_1 , VV.VCATN_END_YMD AS HOLI_END_1 , CASE WHEN VV.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' THEN '승인' ELSE '' END AS HOLI_STATUS FROM (SELECT BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO , CRTR_YM , BGNG_HR , END_HR , TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD FROM AYC110 WHERE CRTR_YM = SUBSTR(#{WORKYMD},1,6) AND TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD IN ('326') ) MM LEFT OUTER JOIN AYC100 DD ON MM.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = DD.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD AND MM.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = DD.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND DD.WORK_YMD = #{WORKYMD} LEFT OUTER JOIN VCATN_SET VV ON DD.USER_ID = VV.USER_ID AND VV.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' , TIME_SET WHERE TIME_SET.START_TIME = MM.BGNG_HR AND TIME_SET.END_TIME = MM.END_HR ORDER BY TIME_SET.TIME_CODE

/*dsOutreachTime*/
SELECT TIME_SET.TIME_CODE AS TIME_CODE , MM.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AS IDX , MM.BGNG_HR AS START_TIME , MM.END_HR AS END_TIME , ' ' AS CONS_PARTY_IDX , DD.USER_ID AS CONS_ID , (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(SCA100.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 , SAA200 WHERE DD.USER_ID = SAA200.USER_ID AND SAA200.ENFSN_NO = SCA100.ENFSN_NO ) AS CONS_NAME , TO_CHAR(DD.APRV_DT,'YYYYMMDD') AS INS_DATE
, CASE WHEN OO.HR_WORK_TYPE_SE_CD1 > ' ' THEN UPPER(OO.HR_WORK_TYPE_SE_CD1) WHEN OO.HR_WORK_TYPE_SE_CD3 > ' ' THEN UPPER(OO.HR_WORK_TYPE_SE_CD3) ELSE UPPER(OO.HR_WORK_TYPE_SE_CD5) END AS T1_WORK_TYPE , CASE WHEN OO.HR_WORK_TYPE_SE_CD2 > ' ' THEN UPPER(OO.HR_WORK_TYPE_SE_CD2) WHEN OO.HR_WORK_TYPE_SE_CD4 > ' ' THEN UPPER(OO.HR_WORK_TYPE_SE_CD4) ELSE UPPER(OO.HR_WORK_TYPE_SE_CD6) END AS T2_WORK_TYPE
, (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'VCATN_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = VV.VCATN_SE_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS HOLI_TYPE , VV.VCATN_BGNG_YMD AS HOLI_START_1 , VV.VCATN_END_YMD AS HOLI_END_1 , CASE WHEN VV.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' THEN '승인' ELSE '' END AS HOLI_STATUS FROM (SELECT BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO , CRTR_YM , BGNG_HR , END_HR , TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD FROM AYC110 WHERE CRTR_YM = SUBSTR(#{WORKYMD},1,6) AND TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD IN ('325') ) MM LEFT OUTER JOIN AYC100 DD ON MM.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = DD.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD AND MM.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = DD.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND DD.WORK_YMD = #{WORKYMD} LEFT OUTER JOIN VCATN_SET VV ON DD.USER_ID = VV.USER_ID AND VV.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' LEFT OUTER JOIN AYC120 OO ON DD.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN = OO.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN AND DD.USER_ID = OO.USER_ID , TIME_SET WHERE TIME_SET.START_TIME = MM.BGNG_HR AND TIME_SET.END_TIME = MM.END_HR ORDER BY TIME_SET.TIME_CODE
